scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.v2.json && vite build && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('v1', 'dist/v1', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('assets', 'dist/assets', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('uv7-os-landing.js', 'dist/uv7-os-landing.js'); fs.copyFileSync('favicon.ico', 'dist/favicon.ico'); fs.copyFileSync('vn-gateway-bridge.js', 'dist/vn-gateway-bridge.js'); fs.copyFileSync('site.webmanifest', 'dist/site.webmanifest');"
